race.comment: WHISPERING ROGUE (6) resumes as the horse to beat after ending last campaign with a close fifth in BM65 grade at Ipswich, beaten just over a length despite racing wide. His latest trial was a solid third at Gold Coast and he's well placed to make a bright return. SUM INVICTUS (3) brings race fitness and a strong recent profile, closing hard for third in a Gold Coast BM60 after being near the top of betting, with his previous run also better than it looks after an awkward start and covering ground. SCARTOON (11) had excuses when wide throughout as favourite in a CL3 over 800m at Ipswich and her BM65 second on heavy ground two back keeps her in the contest. SWIFT DUKE (4) resumes with a genuine track-and-trip record and his Eagle Farm BM70 fourth last campaign reads well for this, provided he is sharp enough fresh. DECADAD (1) is also ticking along nicely and reunites with a winning hoop. Keeping safe.
